text:
Anya: Heads-up — saw a utility pole snap at 16th & Mission, SFPD and Muni rerouting buses. Caltrain showing single-track through part of the peninsula. Anyone on their commute?
Mike: Yep — on the 22 right now, they detoured onto Folsom. Bus crawling, ETA +25. :grimacing:
Jamal: Ferry here — winds added 10–15 min. Announcements said secure loose items, lol. :wind_face:
Priya: Power blinked at my apt, so WFH for me today. Hoping the flicker doesn't turn into something worse. :coffee:
Sam: Checked 511 and Caltrain feed — single-track reported between Hillsdale and Belmont until ~09:30. If you're doing South Bay -> SF, expect delays.
Anya: Thanks Sam. Can anyone on the ground confirm if the 16th closure is affecting the 12 bus? I saw a couple of riders walking past the barricade.
Mike: 12 diverted to Valencia. They yelled 'follow the cones' and everyone shuffled. No major drama, just slow.
Jamal: For folks on the Embarcadero: ferry landing had a short hold but they warned it might get cancel-y if gusts pick up.
Priya: FYI I just DM'd facilities — they asked folks near the office to avoid the alley entrance because of debris.
Sam: TransitBot: BART status: normal. (not helpful but comforting)
Anya: If anyone's heading toward SoMa and needs a lift from 7th/Brannan later, I can swing by. Space for 2. :raised_hand:
Mike: If you have room, could you pick up a soggy commuter? My umbrella folded like origami. :umbrella_with_rain_drops:
Priya: Also — small PSA: bring headphones if you're on a delayed train. Someone's acoustic guitar rendition of 'Here Comes the Sun' is not helping. :guitar: :sweat_smile:
Jamal: Squirrel tried to board my ferry, true story. He gave me side-eye like he was judging my sandwich choice. :chipmunk: :joy:
Anya: Updated — SFPD just put out an advisory: avoid 16th between Valencia and Mission for at least an hour. If you can delay your commute, maybe stay local.
Mike: Vote: stay put and make an extra pour-over or brave the slog? :coffee: :boat: :train:
Priya: :coffee: (home brew win)
Sam: :train: (already on the move, might as well suffer elegantly)
Jamal: :boat: (ferry life)
TransitBot: Reminder: if you have scheduled on-site meetings this morning, check Calendar for cancellations from facilities.
Anya: Great — thanks everyone. Keep this thread posted if you see new detours or if anyone needs a ride. :thumbsup:
